lines.text: So what are buyers paying for?
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ wʌt ɑːɹ bˈaɪɚz pˈeɪɪŋ fɔːɹ?

lines.text: A magnet only catches iron and the cheapest grades.
lines.phonemes: ɐ mˈæɡnɪt ˈoʊnli kˈætʃᵻz ˈaɪɚn ænd ðə tʃˈiːpɪst ɡɹˈeɪdz.

lines.text: It's nickel: 304 has at least 8%; cheaper grades, far less.
lines.tts: It's nickel: three-oh-four has at least eight percent; cheaper grades, far less.
lines.phonemes: ɪts nˈɪkəl: θɹˈiːˈoʊfˈɔːɹ hɐz æt lˈiːst ˈeɪt pɚsˈɛnt; tʃˈiːpɚ ɡɹˈeɪdz, fˈɑːɹ lˈɛs.

lines.text: So collect 304 offcuts and keep one grade per sack.
lines.tts: So collect three-oh-four offcuts, and keep one grade per sack.
lines.phonemes: sˌoʊ kəlˈɛkt θɹˈiːˈoʊfˈɔːɹ ˈɔfkʌts, ænd kˈiːp wˈʌn ɡɹˈeɪd pɜː sˈæk.

lines.text: Say 500 kilos fetch ₹69,000; buying, sorting and transport leave about ₹7,500.
lines.tts: Say five hundred kilos fetch sixty-nine thousand rupees; buying, sorting and transport leave about seventy-five hundred.
lines.phonemes: sˈeɪ fˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd kˈiːloʊz fˈɛtʃ sˈɪkstinˈaɪn θˈaʊzənd ɹˈuːpiːz; bˈaɪɪŋ, sˈɔːɹɾɪŋ ænd tɹˈænspɔːɹt lˈiːv ɐbˌaʊt sˈɛvəntifˈaɪv hˈʌndɹɪd.

lines.text: Buyers pay for proven grade and volume.
lines.phonemes: bˈaɪɚz pˈeɪ fɔːɹ pɹˈuːvən ɡɹˈeɪd ænd vˈɑːljuːm.

lines.text: Join WastePaisa and put your scrap to use.
lines.phonemes: dʒˈɔɪn wˈeɪst pˈaɪsɑː ænd pˌʊt jʊɹ skɹˈæp tə jˈuːz.
